spec.title: The king walks to his death

segments.say: The black king started on g8, and got checkmated on g1. Here's how.
segments.caption: Lasker vs Thomas, 1912

segments.say: London, 1912. Edward Lasker plays one of the craziest king hunts ever.
segments.caption: Lasker vs Thomas, 1912

segments.say: Queen takes h7, check! The king must take.
segments.caption: Queen sacrifice!

segments.say: Now every white move is a check, and the king gets pulled across the board.
segments.caption: Check after check

segments.say: Bishop e2, check. King g2. Rook h2, check. King g1.
segments.caption: All the way to g1

segments.say: And the king steps to d2. Checkmate.
segments.caption: King d2 mate!

segments.say: The black king walked from g8 to g1. Have you ever seen a king hunt like this?
segments.caption: Craziest king walk?

yt_title: The king walks ACROSS the board to his death 💀 #chess
desc:
Edward Lasker vs George Thomas, London 1912 - the most famous king hunt in chess.

11.Qxh7+!! Kxh7 and then check after check drags the black king from g8 all the way to g1, finished by 18.Kd2#.

Ever seen anything like it? 👇
Follow @stenchess for a new chess trick every day.
